I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I said I'd keep the tip marked as unverified and wouldn't treat Linnea Merriwether as the confirmed contact until someone confirms it.

I couldn't confirm it. Nothing in the shared notes I can read mentions a Hollybank rollout or Linnea Merriwether. The search ran on keywords only, so differently worded mentions could have been missed. Those notes list Marrow Agrisupply as the Central team's ag account, so I told her the Central account owner is the best person to confirm. The notes don't say who the owner is.
